translations.web: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
translations.bsb: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
translations.kjv: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
